semantics.share: explicit owner duplication or unique-to-readonly-frozen conversion, never copy or lock

semantics.guard: RwLock guards authorize multiple readers or one writer, never both
semantics.actor: share does not imply Sendable, Serializable or cross-domain rights
semantics.failure: reject unsupported or unproven semantics before emitting guest
